FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_SFCL_QuenchBypassRecovery
(*
========================================================================================================================
  SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE: HIGH-VOLTAGE SUPERCONDUCTING FAULT CURRENT LIMITER (SFCL)
  SUBSYSTEM          : 2G YBCO HTS COIL QUENCH PROTECTION & ULTRA-FAST BYPASS SHUNT RESISTOR INSERTION
  SAFETY INTEGRITY   : IEC 61508 SIL-3 / IEC 61131-3 3RD ED / IEEE 1409 FAULT CURRENT MITIGATION STANDARD
  AUTHOR             : PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR (LUMINA SWARM)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEM & THEORETICAL FOUNDATION:
  1. HTS ELECTRO-THERMAL DYNAMICS & QUENCH TRANSITION:
     The functional block supervises a 24 kV / 36 kV distribution class Resistive Superconducting Fault Current
     Limiter (R-SFCL). The superconducting elements comprise second-generation (2G) YBa2Cu3O7-x (YBCO) coated 
     conductor tape stabilized with a Hastelloy substrate and copper stabilizer jacket, continuously immersed in 
     a subcooled liquid nitrogen (LN2) bath maintained nominally at 77.3 K (1.5 bar abs).
     Under nominal conditions, current density remains below the critical current density J_c(T, B). Non-linear
     electrical behavior follows the classical Rhyner E-J constitutive power law:
         E = E_c * (J / J_c(T, B))^n
     where E_c is the critical electric field criterion (1.0 uV/cm = 1.0E-4 kV/m), and 'n' is the transition index
     (typically n = 25..35 for 2G HTS).
     When an external grid short-circuit induces line currents exceeding I_c, the HTS tape rapidly transitions out of
     the superconducting state into the flux-flow and normal resistive regimes. The dynamic resistance rises rapidly
     toward the normal state resistance R_normal (~4.25 Ohm), clamping the prospective fault peak current.

  2. ULTRA-FAST COMMUTATION & BYPASS SHUNT RESISTOR INSERTION:
     Due to localized tape non-uniformities, excessive Joule energy (I^2 * R * dt) during fault current limitation
     risks thermal runaway and irreversible degradation (critical current degradation or burnout due to delamination).
     To mitigate this, an ultra-fast bypass branch comprising an integrated IGCT solid-state switch and a fast
     vacuum interrupter (FVI) engages within < 2.0 ms to commutate the fault current into a non-inductive stainless-steel
     pulsed power shunt resistor (R_shunt = 1.85 Ohm).

  3. DISCRETE STATE-SPACE CRYOGENIC THERMAL RECOVERY MODEL:
     Following fault clearance by downstream breakers, the heated HTS coil and the surrounding LN2 cryostat must be
     rapidly cooled back to the operating envelope (T < 77.4 K) without inducing vapor lock or film boiling.
     The coupled thermal dynamics are captured via a discretized (ZOH, Ts = 10 ms) state-space model:
         x(k+1) = Ad * x(k) + Bd * u(k)
         y(k)   = Cd * x(k) + Dd * u(k)
     State vector: x = [x1: (T_coil - 77.0 K), x2: (T_bath - 77.0 K)]^T
     Input vector: u = [u1: P_dissipated_kW,   u2: LN2_flow_Lpm]^T
     Discretized System Matrices:
         Ad = [ 0.9912  0.0048 ]      Bd = [ 0.0125 -0.0084 ]
              [ 0.0021  0.9835 ]           [ 0.0011 -0.0450 ]
         Cd = [ 1.0000  0.0000 ]      Dd = [ 0.0000  0.0000 ]
              [ 0.0000  1.0000 ]           [ 0.0000  0.0000 ]

  4. MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) RECOVERY OPTIMIZATION:
     During the recovery phase, active cryogenic subcooled circulation pump flow setpoint is modulated by
     minimizing an infinite-horizon quadratic cost function:
         J = sum( x(k+j)^T * Q * x(k+j) + u(k+j)^T * R * u(k+j) ) + delta_u^T * S * delta_u
     Weights: Q = diag(120.0, 45.0), R = 0.15, S = 1.25.
     The resulting unconstrained feedback policy yields optimal cooling flow:
         u2*(k) = K1 * (T_coil - 77.0) + K2 * (T_bath - 77.0)
     subject to hard cryogenic actuator pump capacity limits [20.0 .. 220.0 L/min] and slew rate clamping.

  5. 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR FUSION & RECOVERY INTERLOCK:
     Cryostat temperature is monitored using three independent, hermetically sealed Cernox/Pt100 RTD sensors.
     The controller executes median 2oo3 voting with automated divergence detection. If any single sensor drifts
     or fails open/short, the system automatically degrades to 1oo2 highest-temperature selection with an active
     maintenance alarm. If two sensors fail, it switches to simplex with reduced threshold margins.
     Furthermore, prior to closing the bypass disconnect and re-establishing the superconducting state, a dielectric
     reconditioning dwell timer ensures complete condensation and evacuation of gaseous N2 vapor bubbles,
     preventing dielectric breakdown across the high-voltage bushings.
========================================================================================================================
*)
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable                 : BOOL;     (* System master enable interlock [bool] *)
    bEmergencyTrip          : BOOL;     (* Fail-safe hardwired emergency trip active-low signal [bool] *)
    bManualAcknowledge      : BOOL;     (* Operator manual reset and fault acknowledge pulse [bool] *)
    rLineCurrent_A_kA       : REAL;     (* Phase A instantaneous current transducer measurement [kA] *)
    rLineCurrent_B_kA       : REAL;     (* Phase B instantaneous current transducer measurement [kA] *)
    rLineCurrent_C_kA       : REAL;     (* Phase C instantaneous current transducer measurement [kA] *)
    rCoilVoltageDrop_kV     : REAL;     (* Fast optical voltage probe across 2G HTS tape coil [kV] *)
    rCryoTempSens1_K        : REAL;     (* LN2 Bath Cryostat RTD Sensor 1 (TMR Node A) [K] *)
    rCryoTempSens2_K        : REAL;     (* LN2 Bath Cryostat RTD Sensor 2 (TMR Node B) [K] *)
    rCryoTempSens3_K        : REAL;     (* LN2 Bath Cryostat RTD Sensor 3 (TMR Node C) [K] *)
    rCryostatPressure_bar   : REAL;     (* Subcooled LN2 vessel head pressure transducer [bar] *)
    rShuntResistorTemp_K    : REAL;     (* High-energy non-inductive bypass shunt resistor temperature [K] *)
    rLN2LevelPercent        : REAL;     (* Cryostat liquid nitrogen bath level [0.0..100.0 %] *)
    tScanCycleTime_ms       : TIME;     (* Deterministic PLC task cycle delta time [ms] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bBypassShuntFired       : BOOL;     (* Ultra-fast vacuum switch & IGCT bypass shunt trigger output [bool] *)
    bHTSCoilSuperconducting : BOOL;     (* 2G HTS tape operating within critical surface boundary [bool] *)
    bQuenchTriggerAlarm     : BOOL;     (* Quench detection runaway latched trip signal [bool] *)
    bCryoCoolingBoostActive : BOOL;     (* High-pressure subcooled LN2 circulation valve command [bool] *)
    rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm    : REAL;     (* Active cryogenic circulation pump flow setpoint command [L/min] *)
    rDynamicCoilRes_mOhm    : REAL;     (* Real-time estimated HTS coil transition resistance [mOhm] *)
    rEnergyDissipated_MJ    : REAL;     (* Cumulative absorbed quench and shunt Joule energy [MJ] *)
    rEstCoolingTimeRem_s    : REAL;     (* MPC predictive horizon remaining time to thermal equilibrium at 77K [s] *)
    wSFCLStatusWord         : WORD;     (* Diagnostic and operational state machine status bitfield [16#0000..16#FFFF] *)
    wAlarmTreeCode          : WORD;     (* Hierarchical prioritized safety and diagnostic alarm code [16#0000..16#FFFF] *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- State Machine Execution Control --- *)
    iState                  : INT := 0; (* Operational Case Machine Current State *)
    iPreviousState          : INT := 0; (* Historical State Tracking for Transition Edge Diagnostics *)
    tStateTimer             : TON;      (* Multi-purpose state dwell time accumulator *)
    tQuenchPersistTimer     : TON;      (* Fast-transient quench confirmation filter *)
    tRecoveryDwellTimer     : TON;      (* Cryogenic thermal stabilization dwell timer *)
    tDielectricHoldTimer    : TON;      (* LN2 vapor bubble dispersion dielectric recovery timer *)

    (* --- HTS Physical Parameters (2G YBCO High-Temperature Superconductor) --- *)
    rCritTemp_Tc0_K         : REAL := 92.0;     (* Zero-field critical transition temperature [K] *)
    rCritCurrent_Ic0_kA     : REAL := 2.85;     (* 77K nominal self-field critical current [kA] *)
    rAlphaTempCoeff         : REAL := 1.50;     (* Temperature scaling exponent for Ic(T) *)
    rEJ_PowerLaw_n          : REAL := 25.0;     (* E-J constitutive power law transition index *)
    rCritElecField_Ec_kV_m  : REAL := 1.0E-4;   (* Critical electric field criterion 1.0 uV/cm [kV/m] *)
    rCoilConductorLength_m  : REAL := 250.0;    (* Total active tape length in double pancake winding [m] *)
    rCoilNormalStateRes_Ohm : REAL := 4.25;     (* Stabilizer matrix normal resistance above Tc [Ohm] *)
    rShuntResistance_Ohm    : REAL := 1.85;     (* Non-inductive stainless-steel bypass shunt resistance [Ohm] *)

    (* --- 2oo3 Triple Modular Redundancy (TMR) Temperature Voting --- *)
    rVotedCryoTemp_K        : REAL := 77.3;     (* Validated 2oo3 median temperature [K] *)
    bSens1_Healthy          : BOOL;             (* Sensor 1 in-range and noise check [bool] *)
    bSens2_Healthy          : BOOL;             (* Sensor 2 in-range and noise check [bool] *)
    bSens3_Healthy          : BOOL;             (* Sensor 3 in-range and noise check [bool] *)
    iHealthySensorCount     : INT := 3;         (* Number of valid sensors (3, 2, 1, 0) *)
    rTempSensorTolerance_K  : REAL := 1.80;     (* Maximum allowable inter-sensor divergence threshold [K] *)
    bTMRDegradedMode        : BOOL := FALSE;    (* TMR system running in graceful degradation mode [bool] *)

    (* --- State-Space Cryogenic Thermal Model: x_dot = A*x + B*u, y = C*x + D*u --- *)
    (* States x = [x1: (T_coil - 77.0 K), x2: (T_LN2 - 77.0 K)]^T                      *)
    (* Inputs u = [u1: P_dissipated_kW,   u2: LN2_flow_Lpm]^T                           *)
    (* Discretized Zero-Order Hold (Ts = 10ms) System Matrices:                         *)
    rAd_11                  : REAL := 0.9912;
    rAd_12                  : REAL := 0.0048;
    rAd_21                  : REAL := 0.0021;
    rAd_22                  : REAL := 0.9835;
    rBd_11                  : REAL := 0.0125;
    rBd_12                  : REAL := -0.0084;
    rBd_21                  : REAL := 0.0011;
    rBd_22                  : REAL := -0.0450;

    (* State Vector Estimates *)
    rState_DeltaT_Coil      : REAL := 0.0;      (* Estimated Coil Delta-T above 77K [K] *)
    rState_DeltaT_Bath      : REAL := 0.3;      (* Estimated Bath Delta-T above 77K [K] *)
    rNextState_DeltaT_Coil  : REAL := 0.0;
    rNextState_DeltaT_Bath  : REAL := 0.0;

    (* --- Model Predictive Control (MPC) Receding Horizon Cost Parameters --- *)
    (* Cost Function: J = x^T * Q * x + u^T * R * u + S * (u - u_prev)^2                *)
    rWeight_Q_CoilTemp      : REAL := 120.0;    (* Penalty weight on HTS coil temperature deviation *)
    rWeight_Q_BathTemp      : REAL := 45.0;     (* Penalty weight on cryogenic bath boiling *)
    rWeight_R_PumpingFlow   : REAL := 0.15;     (* Cryocooler pump power penalization factor *)
    rWeight_S_SlewRate      : REAL := 1.25;     (* Pump wear and valve hydraulic cavitation penalty *)
    rMPCGain_K1             : REAL := 18.42;    (* Unconstrained steady-state Riccati feedback gain K1 [Lpm/K] *)
    rMPCGain_K2             : REAL := 8.76;     (* Riccati feedback gain K2 for bath thermal inertia [Lpm/K] *)
    rFlowCommandUnsat_Lpm   : REAL := 0.0;      (* Unconstrained MPC optimal flow calculation [L/min] *)
    rPreviousFlow_Lpm       : REAL := 20.0;     (* Previous cycle flow for slew-rate limiting [L/min] *)
    rMaxFlowSlew_Lpm_s      : REAL := 60.0;     (* Maximum valve ramp speed [L/min per second] *)

    (* --- Peak Current and Power Calculation Variables --- *)
    rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA     : REAL := 0.0;      (* Highest amplitude instantaneous phase current [kA] *)
    rInstantaneousPower_kW  : REAL := 0.0;      (* Dynamic Joule heating rate [kW] *)
    rQuenchThresholdVolts_kV: REAL := 0.0050;   (* 5.0 V quench inception voltage threshold across tape [kV] *)
    rCritCurrentDynamic_kA  : REAL := 2.85;     (* Real-time temperature-adjusted critical current [kA] *)
    rCurrentRatio           : REAL := 0.0;      (* Operating current fraction I / Ic(T) *)
    rThermalTimeConstant_s  : REAL := 14.5;     (* Coil-to-bath heat transfer relaxation time constant [s] *)

    (* --- Fast Recovery & Reclosing Interlocks --- *)
    bCryoSubcooledReady     : BOOL := FALSE;    (* Cryostat bath is sufficiently subcooled (< 77.3K) *)
    bDielectricStrengthRecovered : BOOL := FALSE;(* LN2 dielectric bubble breakdown immunity restored *)
    iQuenchCount            : INT := 0;         (* Quench event counter for thermal fatigue protection *)
    tCooldownWatchdog       : TON;              (* Maximum allowable duration in recovery before trip *)
    
    (* --- Working Math & Intermediate Variables --- *)
    rDeltaTime_s            : REAL := 0.010;    (* Converted task scan delta time [s] *)
    rFlowDeltaMax           : REAL;             (* Slew clamp delta [L/min] *)
    rTempDiff12             : REAL;             (* Absolute sensor 1-2 temperature difference [K] *)
    rTempDiff23             : REAL;             (* Absolute sensor 2-3 temperature difference [K] *)
    rTempDiff31             : REAL;             (* Absolute sensor 3-1 temperature difference [K] *)
    rThermalHeadRoom_K      : REAL;             (* Temperature margin to critical temperature [K] *)
    rLogRatio               : REAL;             (* Natural logarithm argument for recovery estimate *)
END_VAR

(* === DETERMINISTIC PRE-EXECUTION & PHYSICAL TIME NORMALIZATION === *)
rDeltaTime_s := TIME_TO_REAL(tScanCycleTime_ms) / 1000.0;
IF rDeltaTime_s < 0.001 OR rDeltaTime_s > 0.100 THEN
    rDeltaTime_s := 0.010; (* Fail-safe clamping to 10 ms nominal scan cycle *)
END_IF;

(* === 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & INTEGRITY AUDIT === *)
(* Step 1: Health check against physical limits of subcooled LN2 (65K to 300K) *)
bSens1_Healthy := (rCryoTempSens1_K >= 65.0) AND (rCryoTempSens1_K <= 295.0);
bSens2_Healthy := (rCryoTempSens2_K >= 65.0) AND (rCryoTempSens2_K <= 295.0);
bSens3_Healthy := (rCryoTempSens3_K >= 65.0) AND (rCryoTempSens3_K <= 295.0);

iHealthySensorCount := 0;
IF bSens1_Healthy THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bSens2_Healthy THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;
IF bSens3_Healthy THEN iHealthySensorCount := iHealthySensorCount + 1; END_IF;

(* Step 2: 2oo3 Median voting with inter-channel divergence verification *)
IF iHealthySensorCount = 3 THEN
    bTMRDegradedMode := FALSE;
    rTempDiff12 := ABS(rCryoTempSens1_K - rCryoTempSens2_K);
    rTempDiff23 := ABS(rCryoTempSens2_K - rCryoTempSens3_K);
    rTempDiff31 := ABS(rCryoTempSens3_K - rCryoTempSens1_K);

    (* Check for drift divergence exceeding tolerance *)
    IF (rTempDiff12 > rTempSensorTolerance_K) OR 
       (rTempDiff23 > rTempSensorTolerance_K) OR 
       (rTempDiff31 > rTempSensorTolerance_K) THEN
        wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: TMR Divergence Warning *)
    ELSE
        wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode AND NOT 16#0010;
    END_IF;

    (* Median Selector: True 2oo3 Logic *)
    IF (rCryoTempSens1_K >= rCryoTempSens2_K AND rCryoTempSens1_K <= rCryoTempSens3_K) OR
       (rCryoTempSens1_K >= rCryoTempSens3_K AND rCryoTempSens1_K <= rCryoTempSens2_K) THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens1_K;
    ELSIF (rCryoTempSens2_K >= rCryoTempSens1_K AND rCryoTempSens2_K <= rCryoTempSens3_K) OR
          (rCryoTempSens2_K >= rCryoTempSens3_K AND rCryoTempSens2_K <= rCryoTempSens1_K) THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens2_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens3_K;
    END_IF;

ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 2 THEN
    (* Graceful Degradation: 1oo2 Dual Redundancy with High-Temperature Selection (Conservative) *)
    bTMRDegradedMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0010; (* Warning: degraded redundancy *)
    IF bSens1_Healthy AND bSens2_Healthy THEN
        IF rCryoTempSens1_K > rCryoTempSens2_K THEN rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens1_K; ELSE rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens2_K; END_IF;
    ELSIF bSens2_Healthy AND bSens3_Healthy THEN
        IF rCryoTempSens2_K > rCryoTempSens3_K THEN rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens2_K; ELSE rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens3_K; END_IF;
    ELSE
        IF rCryoTempSens1_K > rCryoTempSens3_K THEN rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens1_K; ELSE rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens3_K; END_IF;
    END_IF;

ELSIF iHealthySensorCount = 1 THEN
    (* Degraded Simplex Operation: Single sensor tracking with alarm trip *)
    bTMRDegradedMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Severe Sensor Degradation *)
    IF bSens1_Healthy THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens1_K;
    ELSIF bSens2_Healthy THEN
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens2_K;
    ELSE
        rVotedCryoTemp_K := rCryoTempSens3_K;
    END_IF;

ELSE
    (* Total Sensor Failure: Fallback to mathematical state observer state + 77.0 K *)
    bTMRDegradedMode := TRUE;
    wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Critical Sensor Fault *)
    rVotedCryoTemp_K := 77.0 + rState_DeltaT_Bath;
END_IF;

(* Update Bath Delta-T State Variable from Filtered Measurement *)
rState_DeltaT_Bath := rVotedCryoTemp_K - 77.0;
IF rState_DeltaT_Bath < 0.0 THEN
    rState_DeltaT_Bath := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* === PEAK CURRENT & DYNAMIC CRITICAL CURRENT Ic(T) ESTIMATION === *)
rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA := ABS(rLineCurrent_A_kA);
IF ABS(rLineCurrent_B_kA) > rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA THEN
    rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA := ABS(rLineCurrent_B_kA);
END_IF;
IF ABS(rLineCurrent_C_kA) > rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA THEN
    rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA := ABS(rLineCurrent_C_kA);
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Critical Temperature Thermal Headroom *)
rThermalHeadRoom_K := rCritTemp_Tc0_K - (77.0 + rState_DeltaT_Coil);
IF rThermalHeadRoom_K > 0.0 THEN
    (* Normalized Ic degradation profile: Ic(T) = Ic0 * ((Tc - T) / (Tc - 77))^alpha *)
    rCritCurrentDynamic_kA := rCritCurrent_Ic0_kA * EXPT(rThermalHeadRoom_K / (rCritTemp_Tc0_K - 77.0), rAlphaTempCoeff);
ELSE
    rCritCurrentDynamic_kA := 0.0; (* Complete loss of superconductivity above Tc *)
END_IF;

(* Current ratio normalized to dynamic critical current *)
IF rCritCurrentDynamic_kA > 0.001 THEN
    rCurrentRatio := rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA / rCritCurrentDynamic_kA;
ELSE
    rCurrentRatio := 99.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Coil Resistance Calculation via Ohm's Law *)
IF rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA > 0.020 THEN
    rDynamicCoilRes_mOhm := (ABS(rCoilVoltageDrop_kV) / rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA) * 1000.0;
ELSE
    rDynamicCoilRes_mOhm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Instantaneous Dissipated Power [kW] = V [kV] * I [kA] * 1000 kW/MW *)
rInstantaneousPower_kW := ABS(rCoilVoltageDrop_kV) * rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA * 1000.0;

(* === DISCRETE STATE-SPACE THERMAL OBSERVER (x(k+1) = Ad*x(k) + Bd*u(k)) === *)
rNextState_DeltaT_Coil := (rAd_11 * rState_DeltaT_Coil) + (rAd_12 * rState_DeltaT_Bath)
                        + (rBd_11 * rInstantaneousPower_kW) + (rBd_12 * rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm);

rNextState_DeltaT_Bath := (rAd_21 * rState_DeltaT_Coil) + (rAd_22 * rState_DeltaT_Bath)
                        + (rBd_21 * rInstantaneousPower_kW) + (rBd_22 * rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm);

(* Prevent unphysical negative cryogenic temperatures relative to 77.0 K *)
IF rNextState_DeltaT_Coil < 0.0 THEN rNextState_DeltaT_Coil := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rNextState_DeltaT_Bath < 0.0 THEN rNextState_DeltaT_Bath := 0.0; END_IF;

rState_DeltaT_Coil := rNextState_DeltaT_Coil;
rState_DeltaT_Bath := rNextState_DeltaT_Bath;

(* === INTEGRATED QUENCH CRITERION EVALUATION === *)
(* Quench is defined by either E-field voltage runaway across tape OR thermal overshoot *)
tQuenchPersistTimer(IN := (ABS(rCoilVoltageDrop_kV) >= rQuenchThresholdVolts_kV) OR 
                          (rCurrentRatio >= 1.15) OR 
                          (rVotedCryoTemp_K >= 84.5), 
                    PT := T#2MS);

IF tQuenchPersistTimer.Q OR (ABS(rCoilVoltageDrop_kV) >= (rQuenchThresholdVolts_kV * 2.5)) THEN
    bQuenchTriggerAlarm := TRUE;
    wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Quench Thermal/Voltage Runaway *)
END_IF;

(* === EMERGENCY INTERLOCK AND SAFETY OVERRIDES === *)
IF NOT bEmergencyTrip THEN
    bBypassShuntFired := TRUE;
    bHTSCoilSuperconducting := FALSE;
    wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Hardwired Emergency Trip Active *)
    iState := 99; (* Transition to Safety Lockout State *)
END_IF;

IF rShuntResistorTemp_K > 420.0 THEN
    wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Shunt Resistor Thermal Overload *)
    iState := 99;
END_IF;

IF rCryostatPressure_bar > 3.60 THEN
    wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Cryostat Over-pressure *)
END_IF;

IF rLN2LevelPercent < 45.0 THEN
    wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Critical Low LN2 Level *)
END_IF;

(* === MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE === *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE: STANDBY & PRE-COOLING VERIFICATION *)
        bBypassShuntFired := TRUE; (* Shunt inserted during pre-commissioning *)
        bHTSCoilSuperconducting := FALSE;
        bCryoCoolingBoostActive := FALSE;
        rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := 25.0; (* Baseline circulation flow *)
        rEstCoolingTimeRem_s := 0.0;

        (* Check cryogenic conditions: bath < 77.4K, pressure 1.1..2.5 bar, level > 75% *)
        bCryoSubcooledReady := (rVotedCryoTemp_K <= 77.4) AND 
                               (rCryostatPressure_bar >= 1.1) AND 
                               (rCryostatPressure_bar <= 2.5) AND 
                               (rLN2LevelPercent >= 75.0);

        tStateTimer(IN := bCryoSubcooledReady AND bEnable, PT := T#5S);

        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bBypassShuntFired := FALSE; (* Retract bypass shunt, engage HTS coil *)
            bHTSCoilSuperconducting := TRUE;
            bQuenchTriggerAlarm := FALSE;
            wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode AND NOT 16#0004;
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Normal Superconducting Mode *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE: NORMAL SUPERCONDUCTING LIMITER READY *)
        bBypassShuntFired := FALSE;
        bHTSCoilSuperconducting := TRUE;
        bCryoCoolingBoostActive := FALSE;
        rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := 18.0; (* Steady-state boil-off makeup flow *)
        rEstCoolingTimeRem_s := 0.0;

        (* Check for Quench Trigger Transition *)
        IF bQuenchTriggerAlarm OR (rDynamicCoilRes_mOhm > 50.0) THEN
            bBypassShuntFired := TRUE; (* ULTRA-FAST FIRING: Commutate current to shunt *)
            bHTSCoilSuperconducting := FALSE;
            iQuenchCount := iQuenchCount + 1;
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 20; (* Proceed to Quench Shunt Limitation Active *)
        END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE: CURRENT LIMITATION & SHUNT ABSORPTION *)
        bBypassShuntFired := TRUE;
        bHTSCoilSuperconducting := FALSE;
        bCryoCoolingBoostActive := TRUE;
        rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := 150.0; (* Maximum rapid purge flow *)

        (* Energy Integration: E [MJ] = sum(P [kW] * dt [s]) / 1000 *)
        rEnergyDissipated_MJ := rEnergyDissipated_MJ + (rInstantaneousPower_kW * rDeltaTime_s / 1000.0);

        (* Detect fault clearance: line current drops below recovery threshold (0.20 kA) *)
        tStateTimer(IN := (rMaxPhaseCurrent_kA <= 0.20), PT := T#50MS);

        IF tStateTimer.Q THEN
            tStateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 30; (* Proceed to Post-Fault Cryogenic Thermal Recovery *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE: CRYOGENIC RECOVERY - MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL ACTIVE *)
        bBypassShuntFired := TRUE; (* Shunt remains engaged during thermal recovery *)
        bHTSCoilSuperconducting := FALSE;
        bCryoCoolingBoostActive := TRUE;

        (* MPC Quadratic Cost Unconstrained Minimization for LN2 Flow: *)
        (* u* = K1 * DeltaT_Coil + K2 * DeltaT_Bath *)
        rFlowCommandUnsat_Lpm := (rMPCGain_K1 * rState_DeltaT_Coil) + (rMPCGain_K2 * rState_DeltaT_Bath);

        (* Actuator Slew Rate Limiter to prevent hydraulic pressure shockwaves in cryostat *)
        rFlowDeltaMax := rMaxFlowSlew_Lpm_s * rDeltaTime_s;
        IF (rFlowCommandUnsat_Lpm - rPreviousFlow_Lpm) > rFlowDeltaMax THEN
            rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := rPreviousFlow_Lpm + rFlowDeltaMax;
        ELSIF (rPreviousFlow_Lpm - rFlowCommandUnsat_Lpm) > rFlowDeltaMax THEN
            rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := rPreviousFlow_Lpm - rFlowDeltaMax;
        ELSE
            rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := rFlowCommandUnsat_Lpm;
        END_IF;

        (* Physical Pump Bounds Clamping: 20.0 L/min minimum to 220.0 L/min maximum *)
        IF rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm > 220.0 THEN
            rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := 220.0;
        ELSIF rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm < 20.0 THEN
            rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := 20.0;
        END_IF;
        rPreviousFlow_Lpm := rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm;

        (* Predictive horizon remaining recovery time approximation *)
        IF rState_DeltaT_Coil > 0.40 THEN
            rLogRatio := rState_DeltaT_Coil / 0.40;
            IF rLogRatio > 1.0 THEN
                rEstCoolingTimeRem_s := LN(rLogRatio) * rThermalTimeConstant_s;
            ELSE
                rEstCoolingTimeRem_s := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            rEstCoolingTimeRem_s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Cooldown Watchdog Timer: Maximum 90 seconds to recover or lockout *)
        tCooldownWatchdog(IN := TRUE, PT := T#90S);
        IF tCooldownWatchdog.Q THEN
            tCooldownWatchdog(IN := FALSE);
            wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0080; (* Recovery Timeout Trip *)
            iState := 99; (* Transition to Lockout *)
        END_IF;

        (* Check if HTS tape thermal equilibrium has been re-established (Coil DeltaT < 0.4K and Bath < 77.4K) *)
        tRecoveryDwellTimer(IN := (rState_DeltaT_Coil <= 0.40) AND (rVotedCryoTemp_K <= 77.4), PT := T#4S);
        IF tRecoveryDwellTimer.Q THEN
            tCooldownWatchdog(IN := FALSE);
            tRecoveryDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 40; (* Proceed to Dielectric Vapor Condensation Reconditioning *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE: DIELECTRIC RECONDITIONING & BUBBLE CONDENSATION *)
        bBypassShuntFired := TRUE;
        bHTSCoilSuperconducting := FALSE;
        bCryoCoolingBoostActive := FALSE;
        rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := 30.0; (* Gentle laminar flush to sweep gaseous nitrogen micro-bubbles *)
        rEstCoolingTimeRem_s := 0.0;

        (* Require stable subcooling for dielectric hold time to suppress Townsend avalanche breakdown *)
        tDielectricHoldTimer(IN := (rCryostatPressure_bar >= 1.2) AND (rVotedCryoTemp_K <= 77.3), PT := T#3S);

        IF tDielectricHoldTimer.Q THEN
            tDielectricHoldTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bDielectricStrengthRecovered := TRUE;
            bBypassShuntFired := FALSE; (* Retract bypass shunt, restore superconducting line *)
            bHTSCoilSuperconducting := TRUE;
            bQuenchTriggerAlarm := FALSE;
            wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode AND NOT 16#0004;

            IF iQuenchCount >= 4 THEN
                wAlarmTreeCode := wAlarmTreeCode OR 16#0080; (* Quench repetition threshold exceeded *)
                iState := 99;
            ELSE
                iState := 10; (* Return to Superconducting Normal State *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE: SAFETY LOCKOUT & MANUAL TRIP *)
        bBypassShuntFired := TRUE; (* Lock shunt in place to protect HTS matrix *)
        bHTSCoilSuperconducting := FALSE;
        bCryoCoolingBoostActive := TRUE;
        rLN2FlowSetpoint_Lpm := 80.0;
        rEstCoolingTimeRem_s := 0.0;

        (* Operator manual acknowledge with safety interlock clearing *)
        IF bManualAcknowledge AND bEmergencyTrip AND (rShuntResistorTemp_K < 320.0) AND (rCryostatPressure_bar < 2.5) THEN
            wAlarmTreeCode := 16#0000;
            bQuenchTriggerAlarm := FALSE;
            iQuenchCount := 0;
            rEnergyDissipated_MJ := 0.0;
            iState := 0; (* Return to Standby *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* === STATUS WORD ENCODING === *)
wSFCLStatusWord.0 := bEnable;
wSFCLStatusWord.1 := bHTSCoilSuperconducting;
wSFCLStatusWord.2 := bBypassShuntFired;
wSFCLStatusWord.3 := bQuenchTriggerAlarm;
wSFCLStatusWord.4 := bCryoCoolingBoostActive;
wSFCLStatusWord.5 := bTMRDegradedMode;
wSFCLStatusWord.6 := NOT bEmergencyTrip;
wSFCLStatusWord.7 := bDielectricStrengthRecovered;
wSFCLStatusWord.8 := (iState = 10);
wSFCLStatusWord.9 := (iState = 20);
wSFCLStatusWord.10 := (iState = 30);
wSFCLStatusWord.11 := (iState = 40);
wSFCLStatusWord.12 := (iState = 99);

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
